pr_comment: @mcraj017 please merge this change to master.
Hello @mcraj017 @christianhaeubl is there any chance we could get this (and https://github.com/oracle/graal/pull/3639) backported to a potential 21.2.0.x bug-fix release?
@zakkak Sure, I will check about the possibility of a potential 21.2.0.x bug-fix release and let you know

Hi @zakkak
Is there any specific reason for 21.2.0.x bug-fix release?
Can it be solved with our dev releases? 
Our next release cycle is on 19 Oct 2021, can we add them in that cycle?

> Hi @zakkak
> Is there any specific reason for 21.2.0.x bug-fix release?

21.2 added JFR support but it looks like https://github.com/oracle/graal/issues/3608 prevents some (basic to my understanding) use cases.
In mandrel we chose to backport the fix (see https://github.com/graalvm/mandrel/pull/281) and we will soon do a bug-fix release, since we would like to get the JFR feature tested as much as possible before the 21.3 LTS release.

> Can it be solved with our dev releases?
> Our next release cycle is on 19 Oct 2021, can we add them in that cycle?

Sure, as it's a new feature I guess it's OK to wait for the next dev release for a fix.
